Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria.

4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible for any purchase preference. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Intended application: Sterilization of laboratory media, glassware, cultur e media, instruments, liquids, garments, waste, microbiological materials and ot her laboratory articles used in research laboratories, hospitals, pharmaceutical industries, biotechnology laboratories and educational institutions. Sr. Technical Specification / Requirement Specificati No. ons Accept ed by Selle r (Yes/No) 1 The Vertical Autoclave must be suitable for sterilization o f laboratory media, glassware, culture media, instrument s, liquids, garments, waste, microbiological materials and other laboratory articles used in research laboratories, h ospitals, pharmaceutical industries, biotechnology labora tories and educational institutions. 2 The autoclave shall have a minimum chamber capacity o f 100 litres. 3 The chamber shall be constructed of SS 304 stainless ste el with mirror finish and corrosion-resistant construction. 4 The outer body shall be fabricated from heavy-duty pow der-coated GI steel or equivalent corrosion-resistant mat erial. 5 The lid shall be made of SS 304 stainless steel with heat- resistant gasket to ensure leak-proof sealing. 6 The chamber shall be designed for an operating pressure of 15–20 psi or higher. 7 The operating temperature range shall be 105°C to 134° C or better. 8 The temperature control accuracy shall be ±1°C or bette r. 9 The autoclave must be provided with a microprocessor-b ased PID controller with colour LCD display or equivalent. 10 The controller shall simultaneously display Set Value (SV) and Present Value (PV).

11 The autoclave shall be equipped with an efficient electric heating system for rapid steam generation. 12 The chamber shall be insulated with high-quality thermal insulation to minimize heat loss. 13 The unit shall be provided with a low water level protecti on system with automatic heater cut-off. 14 The autoclave shall be equipped with a calibrated pressu re gauge for chamber pressure indication. 15 The unit shall be provided with an independent safety valve for over-pressure protection. 16 The lid shall be secured using a robust radial locking arra ngement or equivalent heavy-duty locking mechanism fo r safe operation. 17 The autoclave shall include a steam release valve/drain valve for controlled pressure release. 18 The unit shall be provided with a water level indicator for easy monitoring. 19 The controller shall provide audible and visual alarms for the following conditions 20 The controller shall provide audible and visual alarms for the following conditions: a)Over temperature b) Over pressure c) Low water level d) Sensor failure e) Cycle completion f) System fault 21 The autoclave shall be supplied with SS 304 perforated b asket(s)/container(s) suitable for the chamber capacity. 22 The power supply shall be 230V ±10%, 50 Hz AC. 23 The company shall enclose a valid CE Certificate of the q uoted model.

24 The manufacturer shall submit valid IAF-approved ISO Ce rtification. 25 The company shall submit a valid EPR Registration Certifi cate issued by CPCB for electronic and electrical equipm ent, wherever applicable. 26 The bidder shall submit detailed technical compliance al ong with the original product catalogue/brochure of the q uoted model. 27 The bidder shall submit a valid authorization certificate fr om the OEM, wherever applicable. 28 The bidder shall provide a NABL-traceable calibration cer tificate at the time of installation. 29 The bidder shall provide IQ, OQ and PQ documentation, wherever applicable, at the time of installation. 30 Pre BID interaction certificate must be provided for beco ming eligible during technical evaluation. 31 Warranty: The complete system shall be supplied with O ne (01) Year Comprehensive Warranty from the date of s uccessful installation and acceptance. . 8.
